```{python}
from pathlib import Path
 
import ee
import geemap
import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd

PROJECT = "ee-jshannon13"      # <- change this
GPKG = "data/nhgis_blockgroup_ca_or_wa_2020.gpkg"          # block group centroids
LAYER = None                                          # set if the gpkg has several layers
ID_COL = "GISJOIN"                                    # unique block group ID column
STATES = ["CA", "OR", "WA"]
YEAR = 2021                                           # NLCD release and imagery year
START, END = f"{YEAR}-06-01", f"{YEAR}-09-01"         # summer window for LST/NDVI
SAMPLE_SCALE = 30                                     # extraction scale (m)
SAMPLE_CHUNK_SIZE = 1000                              # points per extraction request

OUT = Path("data/gee_out_bg")
(OUT / "chunks").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

try:
    ee.Initialize(project=PROJECT)
except Exception:
    ee.Authenticate()
    ee.Initialize(project=PROJECT)

```


Step 1: study region (limits the Landsat search to the three states)

```{python}
states = (
    ee.FeatureCollection("TIGER/2018/States")
    .filter(ee.Filter.inList("STUSPS", STATES))
)
region = states.geometry()

```

Step 2: predictor stack

```{python}
nlcd = (
    ee.ImageCollection("USGS/NLCD_RELEASES/2021_REL/NLCD")
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq("system:index", str(YEAR)))
    .first()
    .select(["landcover", "impervious"])
    .rename(["nlcd_class", "impervious_pct"])
)
 
 
def mask_and_scale(img):
    """Cloud/shadow/snow mask; scale Landsat C2 L2 SR to reflectance and ST to deg C."""
    qa = img.select("QA_PIXEL")
    clear = (
        qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)        # dilated cloud
        .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))  # cloud
        .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))  # cloud shadow
        .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0))  # snow
    )
    sr = img.select("SR_B.").multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    lst = (
        img.select("ST_B10").multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15)
        .rename("lst_c")
    )
    return sr.addBands(lst).updateMask(clear)
 
 
landsat = (
    ee.ImageCollection("LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2")
    .merge(ee.ImageCollection("LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2"))
    .filterBounds(region)
    .filterDate(START, END)
    .map(mask_and_scale)
)
comp = landsat.median()
 
ndvi = comp.normalizedDifference(["SR_B5", "SR_B4"]).rename("ndvi")
ndbi = comp.normalizedDifference(["SR_B6", "SR_B5"]).rename("ndbi")
ndwi = comp.normalizedDifference(["SR_B3", "SR_B5"]).rename("ndwi")
lst = comp.select("lst_c")
 
terrain = ee.Terrain.products(ee.Image("USGS/SRTMGL1_003")).select(
    ["elevation", "slope", "aspect"]
)
 
tree_cover = (
    ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/061/MOD44B")
    .filterDate(f"{YEAR}-01-01", f"{YEAR}-12-31")
    .first()
    .select("Percent_Tree_Cover")
    .rename("tree_cover_pct")
)
 
prism = ee.ImageCollection("OREGONSTATE/PRISM/ANm").filterDate(START, END)
prism_tmean = prism.select("tmean").mean().rename("prism_tmean_c")
prism_ppt = prism.select("ppt").sum().rename("prism_ppt_mm")
 
stack = nlcd.addBands(
    [ndvi, ndbi, ndwi, lst, terrain, tree_cover, prism_tmean, prism_ppt]
)

```

Step 3: load block group centroids


```{python}
pts = gpd.read_file(GPKG)
 
# Earth Engine needs lon/lat (WGS84)
pts = pts.to_crs(4326)


pts["lon"] = pts.geometry.x
pts["lat"] = pts.geometry.y
print(f"{len(pts):,} block group centroids loaded")
print(pts.head())

```

Step 4: sample predictors in chunks (resumable; one CSV per chunk)


```{python}

def fc_to_df(fc):
    feats = fc.getInfo()["features"]
    return pd.DataFrame([f["properties"] for f in feats])

n_chunks = -(-len(pts) // SAMPLE_CHUNK_SIZE)  # ceiling division
 
for k, start in enumerate(range(0, len(pts), SAMPLE_CHUNK_SIZE), start=1):
    chunk_path = OUT / "chunks" / f"samples_{start:06d}.csv"
    if chunk_path.exists():
        continue
    chunk = pts.iloc[start : start + SAMPLE_CHUNK_SIZE][[ID_COL, "geometry"]]
    samples = stack.sampleRegions(
        collection=geemap.gdf_to_ee(chunk),   # GeoDataFrame -> ee.FeatureCollection
        properties=[ID_COL],
        scale=SAMPLE_SCALE,
        tileScale=8,
    )
    df = fc_to_df(samples)                    # ee.FeatureCollection -> DataFrame
    df.to_csv(chunk_path, index=False)
    print(f"Chunk {k}/{n_chunks}: sampled {len(chunk)}, kept {len(df)}")
```

%% Step 5: merge, label, QA, save


```{python}
NLCD_LABELS = {
    11: "Open water", 12: "Perennial ice/snow", 21: "Developed, open space",
    22: "Developed, low", 23: "Developed, medium", 24: "Developed, high",
    31: "Barren", 41: "Deciduous forest", 42: "Evergreen forest", 43: "Mixed forest",
    52: "Shrub/scrub", 71: "Grassland", 81: "Pasture/hay", 82: "Cultivated crops",
    90: "Woody wetlands", 95: "Herbaceous wetlands",
}
 
samples = pd.concat(
    [pd.read_csv(p, dtype={ID_COL: str}) for p in sorted((OUT / "chunks").glob("samples_*.csv"))],
    ignore_index=True,
)
# Left join keeps every block group; rows lost to cloud masking have NaN predictors
final = pts.merge(samples, on=ID_COL, how="left")
final["nlcd_label"] = final["nlcd_class"].map(NLCD_LABELS)
final["developed"] = final["nlcd_class"].between(21, 24).astype("Int64").where(
    final["nlcd_class"].notna()
)
 
missing = final["lst_c"].isna().sum()
print(f"Block groups: {len(final):,} | missing predictors (masked/no data): {missing:,}")
print(final["developed"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename({0: "other", 1: "developed"}))
print(final.describe().T[["count", "mean", "min", "max"]].round(2))
print(final.groupby("nlcd_label")[["lst_c", "ndvi", "impervious_pct"]].mean().round(2))
 
final.drop(columns="geometry").to_csv(OUT / "bg_centroids_covariates.csv", index=False)
final.to_file(OUT / "bg_centroids_covariates.gpkg", driver="GPKG")
 
# Quick map check
final.plot(column="lst_c", markersize=1, legend=True, figsize=(5, 7))

```
